notes: Exposure: share of teams holding the player (mine: my teams in that window; field: every team in it). Drafted%: share of that window's pods that drafted him. lift10: top-10% lift against same-contest, same-price teams (money_report.md). verdict: the MONEY column of decision_register.csv as approved; current: this run's read (after the price-split check where it ran). mine: my teams where the decision applied, season to date (top-10% and top-1% rates over the field's). A player's lift10: his holders' top-10% rate over the window's (20+ holders). results: my teams last night (fees and winnings in dollars, finishes as top x%). card: my teams last night at each turn (faller, reach, trust; a reach's direction) and holding same-position teammates or opposing stars, with how many finished top 10%. card_decisions: per draft-card decision, last night and season to date, my teams doing it (share of my teams at that turn, or of all my teams) against the field's share, and vs_field_top1 / vs_field_top10: the top-1% and top-10% rate of the field's teams doing it over the whole field's rate in their contest (every team counts; no price matching, so a cheaper or pricier build's edge is in it). One night is noisy; the season line is the read. player_multiples: per night, am/pm/all, each player's {teams, share, top1, top10: [multiple, finishes, expected], mine: {teams, share}} by the lineups holding him (share of top-x% lineups over share of all; drafted picks, swapped_in apart). groups_by_night: the same for T3/T4 by flag, T4 PRICEY dropped into T5, T5 under/over 60% (without them), elite-break teams. card_decisions_by_night: card_decisions night by night. finish_bins: my lineups' and the field's finish percentiles in 1% bins. t5_drafted.<window>.swaps: the T5 block for swapped-in players.
